sourceTitle: The Gamekeeper at Home: Sketches of Natural History and Rural Life
description: "The Gamekeeper at Home: Sketches of Natural History and Rural Life" by Richard Jefferies is a collection of essays written in the late 19th century. This work explores the life and duties of a gamekeeper, delving into the natural history of rural England, the various wildlife that inhabits it, and the relationship between man and nature in a country setting.
